blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Emilio Aguinaldo College booked its first-ever NCAA Final Four appearance after routing College of St. Benilde, 88-64, in the Season 102 quarterfinals at San Juan Arena on Tuesday night. The Generals, who joined the NCAA in 2009, had never advanced beyond the elimination round before ending that drought with a dominant second-half performance. EAC, the second seed in Group B, used its twice-to-beat advantage to eliminate the Group A third-seeded Blazers and secure a semifinal berth. “It hasn’t been easy for our team.
